newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Beijing Datang HK part of IPO seen oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Beijing Datang HK part of IPO seen oversubscribed.

text.p: The public flotation portion of 124.41 million H-shares of Beijing Datang Power Generation Co Ltd in Hong Kong is expected to be about 100 times subscribed, market sources said at the close of its offering on Friday.
The shares is expected to price near the top end of the range of HK$2.52 per share, sources said.
The company is due to release an official subscription results on March 18. Dealing in the company shares is expected to begin on March 21.
Beijing Datang offered 1.244 billion new H-shares in its flotation at price from HK$2.22 to HK$2.52 each.

Among the issue, 627.01 million H shares would be placed with professional and institutional investors, 492.65 million with New World Infrastructure Ltd and the remaining 124.41 million shares to the public in Hong Kong.
H-shares are shares of mainland Chinese companies listed in Hong Kong.
Datang Power operates coal-fired electric power plants which supply electricity to Beijing and other industrial cities in northern China.
